task.title: Persistent auto-integrator per-run task limit of two

not_changing: required checks / smoke command policy resolution
live execute authority binding to the promoted watchdog root (resolve_execute_authority)
the live crontab -- this task does not edit it; the operator re-runs the installer after this merges

acceptance_1_reproduction.root_cause: run-auto-integrator.sh always forwarded `--max-tasks "$MAX_TASKS"` with MAX_TASKS defaulting to bash-side `${AUTO_INTEGRATOR_MAX_TASKS:-1}`, and main() in auto_integrator.py unconditionally overrides Settings.max_tasks_per_run whenever --max-tasks is present on argv. A bare cron line (no AUTO_INTEGRATOR_MAX_TASKS env var set) therefore always pinned the run to exactly one task per pass regardless of any config-file `auto_integrator.max_tasks_per_run` value.
acceptance_1_reproduction.installed_cron_check: no `# pantheon-auto-integrator` crontab entry is present in this task worktree's execution environment (the live cron lives on the promoted watchdog host, not the worker sandbox); the code-path root cause above was confirmed by reading scripts/run-auto-integrator.sh and scripts/git/auto_integrator.py directly.

observed_backlog_at_reproduction.source: canonical ai-status.json via governed $PANTHEON_COMMAND_ROOT/scripts/ai-status.sh show / direct read of the canonical status file
observed_backlog_at_reproduction.note: counts move continuously as the fleet integrates; these are a live snapshot proving multiple review_approved tasks were already queued behind the one-per-run cap at the time of this task's reproduction, consistent with the task brief's original report of a 9-deep/86-minute backlog recorded earlier in the same incident.

change_summary: auto_integrator.py: Settings.max_tasks_per_run default raised from 1 to 2; load_settings() falls back to 2 (not 1) when auto_integrator.max_tasks_per_run is absent from the resolved config.

run-auto-integrator.sh: --max-tasks is now only forwarded when AUTO_INTEGRATOR_MAX_TASKS is explicitly set in the environment; a bare cron line omits the flag entirely so the settings-derived value (config file, else the raised default of 2) takes effect.

auto_integrator_install.py: adds DEFAULT_MAX_TASKS = 2 as the single declared source, a --max-tasks CLI override, and renders AUTO_INTEGRATOR_MAX_TASKS=<n> directly into the crontab entry so the limit is baked into the installed cron line and survives runtime promotion without depending on an interactive shell or ambient env var.
acceptance_2_persistent_setting.bare_cron_line_default_safety: verified by scripts/test_run_auto_integrator.py::test_execute_mode_without_max_tasks_env_omits_the_flag: with AUTO_INTEGRATOR_MAX_TASKS unset, the wrapper's rendered argv is exactly ["--execute"] (no --max-tasks), so auto_integrator.py's own Settings default (2) governs.
acceptance_2_persistent_setting.installer_render_proof: scripts/test_auto_integrator_install.py::test_render_cron_line_defaults_max_tasks_to_two and ::test_install_cron_cli_default_persists_max_tasks_into_crontab assert the rendered/installed line contains AUTO_INTEGRATOR_MAX_TASKS=2 from DEFAULT_MAX_TASKS with no override supplied; ::test_render_cron_line_renders_explicit_max_tasks_override and ::test_render_cron_line_rejects_non_positive_max_tasks cover the explicit-override and invalid-value paths.

acceptance_3_refresh_against_first_merge.claim: a second (or later) candidate merged in the same run is re-evaluated against the live dev head an earlier candidate's merge in that same run just produced; a candidate that has gone BEHIND as a result is skipped and reported (action=waiting), never force-merged.
acceptance_3_refresh_against_first_merge.mechanism: unchanged existing fences prove this by construction: fetch_refs() re-fetches origin/<target-branch> per candidate; revalidate_before_merge() re-reads canonical state and re-fetches the exact live PR immediately before the synchronous REST merge call and rejects any mergeStateStatus outside {CLEAN, HAS_HOOKS, UNSTABLE, UNKNOWN} (fresh_merge_state not in ALLOWED_DIRECT_MERGE_STATES) with a `waiting` FinalMergeRevalidationError, never issuing the merge PUT.
acceptance_3_refresh_against_first_merge.new_test: scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py::MultiTaskPerRunOrderingTests::test_second_candidate_is_revalidated_against_dev_head_first_merge_produced -- calls integrate_candidate() for two review_approved candidates sharing one runner/gate exactly as main()'s per-run loop would; the fake runner marks every other still-open task's cached PR mergeStateStatus=BEHIND the moment the first candidate's merge PUT lands (mirroring GitHub after dev has advanced). Asserts: first candidate action=merged; second candidate action=waiting with detail containing mergeStateStatus=BEHIND; no merge PUT command was ever issued for the second PR.
acceptance_3_refresh_against_first_merge.coverage_gap_closed: no prior test exercised the final-merge-state-not-direct / BEHIND path at all; this is new coverage, not a behavior change to the merge/authority code.

acceptance_4_fences_unchanged.authority_binding_refusal_proof: scripts/git/test_auto_integrator.py tests selected with `-k "authority or Authority"` (7 tests, 3 subtests) pass unchanged, including the command-root-vs-watchdog-root mismatch refusal in resolve_execute_authority.
